name: moa-ams-platform
description: Express REST API for Ministry of Agriculture Asset Tracking System (MoA-AMS)

scripts.db:setup: prisma generate && prisma db push && tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:upgrade:roles: prisma db execute --file prisma/migrations/202610010001_roles_audit/migration.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate
scripts.db:upgrade:employees: prisma db execute --file prisma/migrations/202610020001_employee_registry/migration.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate
scripts.db:upgrade:reference: prisma db execute --file prisma/migrations/202610030001_reference_data/migration.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate
